components.name: Il2CppNativeKit Loader
components.description: winhttp.dll + dinput8.dll proxy pair that boots the mod loader (compat layer runs folder mods). Install first.

components.name: Gacha Unlock
components.description: Gacha unlock - client mod + server hotpatch installed together. Client goes to Il2CppNativeKit/Mods, server patch goes to bin/patch/<next free number>.

components.name: LocalRadio
components.description: Multi-station custom radio. The GM panel Radio tab injects your stations into this mod after install - the kit ships clean templates.

components.name: ScopeCdnRedirect
components.description: Redirects CDN media requests to a mirror.

components.name: Weapon Unlock
components.description: Unlocks all WeaponConfig weapons client-side (visibility + equip).

components.name: Character Unlock (client)
components.description: Grants every FightSpiritConfig character via the real AddSpirit RPC and unhides owned-but-hidden ones. Auto mode needs the server patch half.

components.name: Character Unlock (server patch)
components.description: Server hotpatch for CharacterUnlock: accepts out-of-config AddSpirit grants and confirms CharacterUnlock.Version. DISABLED on the owner server: AddSpirit returns invalid params with it loaded - under investigation. Do not install until fixed.
